title: Glyph chamfer distance between kanji
description: Built by src/build_glyph_neighbors.py from Noto Sans JP Regular at 64px. Value: max of the two directed mean chamfer distances in px (lower = more alike). nearest: top 50 shipped neighbors per shipped kanji. nearest_unshipped: top 10 other kanjidict.txt kanji within 0.6 px. Closest first.
